visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and a white T-shirt stands in a doorway, holding a white plate filled with sliced pumpkin, corn, and chicken. He looks directly at the camera with a wide smile and active mouth movements. (2) He moves the plate closer to the camera as a large white Samoyed dog pops its head into the frame from below, appearing excited. (3) The scene shifts to a kitchen counter where the man's hands are seen placing pumpkin slices and corn on a wooden cutting board next to raw chicken breast. Yellow text labels the items. (4) The man uses a knife to cut a head of broccoli on the board while the white dog watches intently from the background, its tongue out. (5) A hand turns a black knob on a kitchen stove, igniting a blue gas flame under a white pan with a glass lid. (6) The lid is lifted to reveal the chicken and vegetables steaming inside; the man uses black chopsticks to stir the contents. (7) A wide shot shows the man standing barefoot in the kitchen, attending to the stove while the dog sits patiently on the floor nearby. (8) Hands are shown tearing the cooked pumpkin and broccoli into smaller pieces over a bowl already containing the other ingredients. (9) The Samoyed dog eats vigorously from a bowl placed on a small wooden stand on a light-colored rug. (10) A close-up of the dog's face as it licks the bowl clean with 'yum!' text overlays. (11) The man leans into the frame next to the eating dog, smiling and pointing toward it. (12) The final shot shows the bowl with only three small pieces of food remaining; the dog looks up at the camera.
